name: Taziri Nkhaleb
home: The road; restless after two days still
found: Lead wagon of her caravan; at crossroads, burning incense to Isarna.
appearance: Late 40s. Ochre road robes. Silver measuring-chain belt.
wants: Safe, profitable routes. Vengeance on lizard-men.
oddly_also: Collects road songs. Won’t drink water drawn south of the road.
family: Late husband Irven (Elunad, killed 8 years ago). Sons Khalid (24, return caravans) and Davin (19, Ilmenor scribe). Daughter Sarit (22, Orziben warehouses). Brother Azghar, teamster.
anecdotes: She once outbid a hobgoblin warlord for iron nails using only dried figs and honey.
She navigated through fey-glamoured woods by singing Isarna hymns until dawn.
She refused a Covenant-Bound 'special cargo' offer despite massive payment.
tragedies: Her husband Irven was killed in the southern swamps 8 years ago. She believes lizard-men killed him.
She has a hidden map of 'safe paths' that Irven drew before his death, and guards it obsessively.
She receives coded letters from Davin hinting at dangerous Ilmenor secrets.

caravan.route: Caelrun to Tagmira (primary), broader Luric Marches circuit
caravan.current_leg: Caelrun to Tagmira — party traveling with her
caravan.brother_azghar: Teamster, Taziri's brother, manages the wagons day-to-day
caravan.waystone_observance: Will stop at Waystone of Isarna west of Tagmira for offering (bread, silver thread)
caravan.dm_notes: Taziri is the party's most reliable civilian connection across the Luric Marches. She knows both Caelrun and Tagmira well and can brief the party on surface-level politics of either. She has no knowledge of the undead alliance. Her Isarna observance at the waystone is a natural scene transition into Tagmira.
